summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The TradersAI Large Cap Equity & Cash ETF (HFSP) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. The fund employs an actively managed, intraday trading approach, focused on generating total return. The fund uses proprietary algorithms to trade e-mini futures contracts on the S&P 500 Index, aiming to exploit daily, and minutely, price movements. HFSP was launched on Oct 23, 2024 and is issued by TradersAI.
